location.title: Location
location.description: City to analyze, e.g. Lagos, Nairobi, Accra, Cairo

country.title: Country
country.description: Country the city is in, e.g. Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Egypt

industry.title: Industry / Market
industry.description: Market or product category, e.g. Fashion, Fintech, Food

targetAudience.title: Target Audience (optional)
targetAudience.description: Who this is for, e.g. Women 25-40, University students

maxSignals.title: Max signals to collect
maxSignals.description: How many search results to analyze (higher = more accurate, slower, costs more)
